designThesis: Northline is a make-slot desk, not a boutique shelf: open on the Field Tote product plate with trade facts on the plate edge; primary argument is graded hide + three-week make-slot request — never lifestyle hero, purple SaaS gradient, or star ratings.
subjectGrounding: Northline Leather Goods — small-batch bags/straps; bridle leather, solid brass, vegetable tan; products Field Tote, Belt No. 2, Shoulder Strap; price band DKK 890–2.400; 3-week make-slot; audience cares about hide grade; journey pick product → choose hide → request make-slot; mobile-first; brand ink brown + warm cream + single brass accent; plain trade English; no reviews/testimonials/celebrity clients/free worldwide shipping/lifestyle models.
composition: Mobile-first bench stack: full-bleed product plate first, material stamp line, Hide Grade Strip, price+lead facts, brass Request make-slot CTA, then secondary Belt No. 2 plate and Shoulder Strap row; desktop widens plate and keeps hide chips + CTA as sticky rail — one bench, not magazine or broadsheet.
informationHierarchy: 1) Field Tote product plate 2) material stamp facts (bridle / veg tan / solid brass) 3) hide grade choice 4) price band + 3-week lead time 5) primary CTA Request make-slot 6) secondary products + plain specs only — no testimonials, no fake star rows, no decorative 01/02/03 process trophies.
typography: Display: Barlow Condensed 600–700 for product names (workshop signage, tight tracking, restrained). Body: IBM Plex Sans 400–500 for plain trade English at 45–75ch. Utility: IBM Plex Mono 400–500 for hide grade codes, stitch count, lead time, prices. No luxury serif display. Fallbacks: Arial Narrow / system-ui / ui-monospace.
colourAndMaterialModel: warm-cream #F2EBE0 ground; ink-brown #241912 type/rules; hide-mid #5C4332 secondary; brass #B08A3C single accent on CTA and hardware callouts only; edge-bone #E4D9C8 plate rails and chip wells; soot #120E0B deep borders/focus companion. No purple, no multi-stop SaaS gradients, no acid-neon-on-dark identity.
imageryAndAssetStrategy: Load-bearing product plates field-tote.webp and belt-no-2.webp on cream/edge-bone grounds, no model crops. Optional stitch-macro.webp as single proof inset near specs when available. Shoulder Strap as text+price until a plate exists. Deliberately no lifestyle models, stock handshakes, or review avatars.
interactionConcept: Hide Grade Strip as accessible radiogroup under the primary plate; selection darkens plate edge rail and updates make-slot summary. Motion intensity 2: only 120–180ms edge response on hide change; prefers-reduced-motion instant swap. CTA: Request make-slot. No scroll-jacking or ambient particle effects.
signatureElement: Hide Grade Strip — horizontal hide-grade chips (material swatch wells + ink-brown labels) under the Field Tote plate; the single memorable control that ties plate → grade → make-slot.
primaryRisk: Cream + brown leather ecommerce can still read as generic artisan catalog if plates shrink and copy softens into luxury fluff; mitigate with plate-first fold, stamp facts, mono measurements, make-slot language, and brass only on the CTA.
implementationGuidance: Tokenize the six colours; brass only on primary CTA and small hardware icons. Load only used weights of Barlow Condensed, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono. First paint: Field Tote plate under slim site bar at 375px. Radiogroup for hide grades with visible focus. Fixed CTA copy Request make-slot. Specs limited to hide grade, materials, lead time 3 weeks, price band DKK 890–2.400, stitch count only if known. Absent strap plate → text row. Quality floor: focus visible, reduced-motion, no horizontal overflow, no invented social proof blocks.
unknowns: Exact hide grade label set/codes; stitch-macro.webp not yet have; Shoulder Strap plate not declared have; make-slot UI is lead-time fact only — discrete calendar slots not specified in evidence.
